** LOGICAL-HOST :class:
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 1270333008710
:CUSTOM_ID: SB-KERNEL:LOGICAL-HOST
:ALLOC: HEAP IMMOBILE
:END: 
#+begin_example
LOGICAL-HOST names the structure-class #<STRUCTURE-CLASS SB-KERNEL:LOGICAL-HOST>:
  Class precedence-list: LOGICAL-HOST, SB-KERNEL:HOST, STRUCTURE-OBJECT,
                         SB-PCL::SLOT-OBJECT, T
  Direct superclasses: SB-KERNEL:HOST
  No subclasses.
  Sealed.
  Slots:
    SB-IMPL::PARSE
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'SB-IMPL::PARSE-LOGICAL-NAMESTRING
    SB-IMPL::PARSE-NATIVE
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: (LAMBDA (&REST SB-IMPL::X)
                  (ERROR "called PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING using a ~
                                  logical host: ~S"
                         (FIRST SB-IMPL::X)))
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-LOGICAL-NAMESTRING
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-NATIVE
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: (LAMBDA (&REST SB-IMPL::X)
                  (ERROR "called NATIVE-NAMESTRING using a ~
                                  logical host: ~S"
                         (FIRST SB-IMPL::X)))
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-HOST
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: (LAMBDA (SB-IMPL::X)
                  (SB-IMPL::LOGICAL-HOST-NAME
                   (SB-IMPL::%PATHNAME-HOST SB-IMPL::X)))
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-DIRECTORY
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-LOGICAL-DIRECTORY
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-FILE
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-LOGICAL-FILE
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-ENOUGH
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-ENOUGH-NAMESTRING
    SB-IMPL::UNPARSE-DIRECTORY-SEPARATOR
      Type: SIMPLE-STRING
      Initform: ";"
    SB-INT:SIMPLIFY-NAMESTRING
      Type: FUNCTION
      Initform: #'IDENTITY
    SB-IMPL::CUSTOMARY-CASE
      Type: (MEMBER :UPPER :LOWER)
      Initform: :UPPER
    SB-IMPL::NAME-HASH
      Type: FIXNUM
      Initform: 0
    SB-IMPL::NAME
      Type: SIMPLE-STRING
      Initform: ""
    SB-IMPL::TRANSLATIONS
      Type: LIST
      Initform: NIL
    SB-IMPL::CANON-TRANSLS
      Type: LIST
      Initform: NIL
#+end_example
